notes: A friendly welcome for new trackers: name, look, tabs, currencies and features, then your first account and entry. Coming back? Restore a backup or JSON export right there (Help → Guided setup opens it again).

Your look: a Pastel theme, the Montserrat font, and My own colours for every part of the app (with a warning and Fix it when something's hard to read). The widget can take your card shape too (Settings → Quick entry).
Batch presets: save a batch of rows under a name and load them all back.
Quick entries that need more details now wait in Drafts, and with names on, the quick form has every field.
Budgets by account on the Overview, and ⇅ to rearrange the Overview's sections.
Tours go deeper (inside an account, goal, debt or investment), Help always opens them, and spending shows in red everywhere.
Fixed: the guided setup highlighted the wrong buttons; a leftover "Buckets" label; the Tutorial picker vanishing.
Buckets are now Budgets, and every account has an Unallocated budget for money you haven't given a job yet. Split less than all of it and the rest waits there.
A guided setup for your first account and entry, plus friendlier tours and Help.

Less scrolling: lists and boxes start folded (choose what starts open in Tracker Elements → Layout), add boxes sit above their lists, pin accounts to the top, pick the Overview's sections and accounts, and a Smaller size or a ☰ menu fit more on screen.
Presets: update the one you used, fill batch rows from one, delete them even after use. Save an unfinished entry as a draft.
Transfers show what's available in the budget you're moving from, and can't take more.
Fixed: the quick-entry form now reopens after you press Back; odd codes no longer show instead of quote marks; backups move between the web and phone apps both ways.
Your own icon on the home screen: Settings → Personalise → Home-screen icon → Add to home screen places a Treasury shortcut with your letters or picture, and it follows later changes.
What's new after an update: a notice the first time you unlock, and Settings → App version lists this version's changes and earlier ones, even offline.
"Don't ask again" on a page tour now stops all page-tour offers; Help → Offer page tours again brings them back.
Fixed: the icon preview in Personalise was blank on the phone.
First release of Treasury for Android
Your records stay only on your phone, encrypted
Quick entry from the home-screen widget
